Removing it degrades UX (loses the telemetry participation signal) but breaks nothing epistemic-identity-critical, matching CLAUDE.md's Install-tiers T2 definition. Sits alongside the T1-tagged engram_log_emitter.py (a different, older system -- the two-level session event log, load-bearing for the drowsiness meter/continuity) without inheriting its tier. UPDATED by WS5 (server-side wiring): five T1/essential files (server.py, engram_derive.py, engram_observation.py, engram_query.py, engram_revision.py) now import this module -- but each does so via a guarded `try/except ImportError`-style import with a no-op stub fallback (`write_telemetry_record(...) -> False`), never a plain top-level import, specifically so this file's own T2 tier is preserved without those five files silently breaking on an Essential-only build that excludes it (tests/test_tiers_manifest.py::test_import_dep_tier_consistency enforces the absence of a HARD dependency; the guarded-import shape is what keeps the dependency soft). This is the concrete mechanism behind docs/2574-telemetry-design.md §8's 'telemetry gates nothing T1.'

engram-alpha#2547 colleague review (Ariadne, second pass): the manifest-can-run-from-plugin bar applied consistently means neither packaging json belongs shipped either. tools/release_gates.py load_config() and tools/run_touched_tests.py _load_test_map()/TEST_MAP_PATH both resolve the config path as repo_root-relative src/engram/packaging/<file>.json (release_gates.py:79; run_touched_tests.py:51,61) -- never plugin_root/packaging/<file>.json, which is where the manifest ships them. Verified further: run_touched_tests.py._find_repo_root() requires pytest.ini + tests/ as ancestor markers, both absent from an installed plugin bundle, so it cannot even resolve a repo_root there -- confirmed via source, not assumption. Both tools are themselves dev-tier-shipped but already non-functional from an installed bundle (repo-checkout-only tools) -- a pre-existing, separate issue, out of scope here. Their config companions were never a live recovery: moved to repo_only alongside the source at src/engram/packaging/.
